title: Qdrant connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Qdrant connector instance's settings, read by the native search family's REST client (`loams_connector_search::qdrant`, CN2 Task 15, R15.2): the endpoint, the collection, where the key, vector and payload are in an event, the sink's batching and the scroll source. `api_key` holds the **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189) and is exactly the manifest's `secrets` list. The `key` property is declared because the manifest declares capabilities.sink.upsert: true (CN1 Task 1's semantic rule): the point id is UUID v5 of the key's value, or of the event's ce_id without it.

url.description: The REST endpoint, http:// or https:// (port 6333 by default), with no credentials in it. Loams collections' Qdrant API is an extra target only (OR-2).

api_key.description: The name of the secret holding the API key, sent as the `api-key` header, resolved through the secret store (D189).

key.description: A JSON pointer (or a top-level field name) to the document key in an event's data; the point id is UUID v5 of its value. Without it, the key is the event's ce_id. Either way a replay overwrites the same point.

vector.description: A JSON pointer to the vector: an array of numbers, or an object of named vectors.

payload.description: A JSON pointer to the payload object. Without it, the payload is the whole data object minus a top-level vector.

apply_deletes.description: Apply events carrying loamsop = d as a delete of the point.

batch.description: Points per upsert request at most.

source.description: The scroll source: one split per collection, in point-id order.

with_vector.description: Read the vectors with the payload.

filter.description: A Qdrant filter the scroll is restricted to.

poll_interval_ms.description: With it, a scroll that reached the end starts again from the first point this long after (unchanged points keep their event ids); without it the source reads one pass and ends.
